_note: Curated (loop 39). Verified against Milio's own bin.json spellCalculations + a live wiki fetch (wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Milio). Q 'Ultra Mega Fire Kick' (Damage, 80-320+120%AP) is a single magic hit -- Milio's only ability with unconditional enemy damage. W 'Cozy Campfire' (heal zone) and E 'Warm Hugs' (shield) and R 'Breakout!' (heal + tenacity) all resolve to pure ally-support calcs in their own bin.json (RangePercent/HealingOverTime, ShieldCalc, HealCalc respectively) with zero enemy-damage terms -- all three correctly have no hits. P 'Fired Up!' left auto:true: it enchants Milio AND his allies so that the ENCHANTED CHAMPION's next auto/ability hit deals bonus magic damage scaled off THAT CHAMPION's own AD (7-15% of the enchanted target's AD) plus a burn scaled off Milio's own AP -- when it's an ALLY who is enchanted (the common lane-partner case), the damage is calculated from the ally's stats, not Milio's, which this codebase's combo model (a single champion's own stat resolver) has no mechanism to represent. The self-enchant case (Milio enchants himself) would be resolvable but the calc names (ADBurstRatio/BurnDamage) don't cleanly separate the self-only path from the any-ally-target path in the BIN, so left blocked rather than guessing.
_notePBurn: P PARTIALLY CURATED (loop 499) - the BURN is Milios own, the BURST is not. The old note said Fired Up! scales off the enchanted champions AD and called the whole passive structurally impossible. Half of that holds. Live wiki (wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Milio, fetched 2026-08-21) separates two components: a BURST of 7/11/15% (based on level) of the ENCHANTED TARGETS attack damage, which is an ally stat this project has no resolver for and stays uncurated; and a BURN of 10-50 (based on level) (+20% of MILIOS AP) plus a smaller tick every 0.25s over 1.5 seconds, which is entirely Milios own scaling. BurnDamage resolves cleanly (110 at level 18 with 300 AP = 50 + 0.2 x 300) - it uses the level-interpolated DataValue pair part kind, which the interpreter has supported for some time; the note calling it impossible predates that. Curated as an on-hit rider gated on Upgraded, because the burn only applies while Milio is himself enchanted and no API reports a buff. Default unmet, so a plain Milio attack is unchanged. Only the initial burn is curated; the 0.25s ticks would need the duration knob and are the same escapable-exposure question as any DoT.

P.note: Fired Up!'s burst/burn is scaled off the ENCHANTED CHAMPION's own AD (often an ally, not Milio) -- no ally-stat resolver exists in this codebase. See _note.
